summary: Interplanetary Fund is an AI-powered fundraising and crowdfunding platform: one cohesive, mobile-first ecosystem where people create campaigns, tell their stories, raise support, and get help from a team of AI agents. THE PROBLEM: running a fundraiser is skilled work — writing a story that moves people, producing images and video, promoting across channels — and most campaign creators are not marketers; traditional platforms hand them an empty form and a share button. iFund gives them a team instead: agents that write like professional campaign managers, a creative studio, and guidance that turns a raw personal need into a public campaign a stranger can understand and act on. WHO IT SERVES: (1) campaign creators, especially nontechnical users — the product minimises clicks and form complexity, in plain language, mobile-first; (2) donors and supporters, with honest presentation — verified figures labelled verified, reported figures labelled reported; (3) nonprofit and fundraising hosts, whose campaigns creators can link and promote alongside first-party iFund campaigns. PARTNER-FIRST HYBRID MODEL (owner decision, 2026-11-14): iFund is the operating system for fundraising success — creation, growth, distribution, verified outcome measurement — not a monopoly donation destination. A campaign may link verified, owner-scoped fundraisers hosted on outside platforms; supporters give DIRECTLY at that provider's own checkout. iFund never receives outside-platform donations and forwards them, never takes its first-party withdrawal fee on outside gifts, and never represents an outside link as an approved partnership — a URL is not proof of ownership or permission. First-party fundraising on iFund (PayPal-based, fee at withdrawal) continues alongside. WHAT IT IS NOT: not a nonprofit (for-profit company); not a donation custodian for other platforms; its AI Campaign Coach is planning and writing help and its quality rubrics explain evidence — they never predict a campaign's success. title: Interplanetary Fund — purpose, problem, audiences, and the partner-first hybrid model
